protocol.inference_scope: One SEL-751; transaction classes; approximate paired-block uncertainty
protocol.level_aware: Supplemental adaptive attack using nearest public levels; no digest values as features
protocol.pooling_assumption: Attacker can group known-same-operation exchanges; never cross blocks or partitions
protocol.stop_rule: 100 complete paired repetitions; no outcome-dependent extension or policy changes
protocol.tuning: Five grouped folds within the first 40 paired repetitions only
